report: This ultrasound case was assessed by the frozen encoder and linear probe, which estimate a 68% probability of malignancy (malignant-leaning). Model confidence in this estimate is moderate (0.35 on a 0-1 scale). The estimate combines 2 views of the image, which differ by at most 0% in probability (the views agree). Lesion-centred views were placed with the dataset's expert mask, which a deployed system would not have. This is a pilot-system output for a course/thesis exercise, not a clinical decision -- see P3_AGENT_NOTES.md for stated limitations.
